_doc: Published numbers the protocol results are compared against (registergap story/sets/SOTA_COMPARISON.md, checked 19-22 Sep 2026). Recall as fractions.

skincap.protocol: Derm1M (Yan et al., ICCV 2025) Table 4: whole SkinCAP as gallery, zero-shot text-to-image
skincap.caveat: our maps see 2,800 in-domain pairs; DermLIP is zero-shot from 1M dermatology pairs; our queries are the 600 held-out captions

rsicd.protocol: standard RSITR: 5,465 test captions, 1,093 gallery, text-to-image R@1/5/10 (iEBAKER, Ji et al. 2025, Table 1)

semart.protocol: Text2Art (Garcia & Vogiatzis 2018): 1,069 test paintings, whole test set as gallery, text-to-image R@1/5/10
semart.caveat: our queries are the description alone

flickr.protocol: Flickr30k Entities pointing game, weakly supervised (no boxes at training)

scimmir.protocol: SciMMIR benchmark uses the full 16,263-pair test set as gallery; fine-tuned BLIP-base+BERT (Wu et al. 2024)
scimmir.caveat: our gallery is a 3,467 subsample; a full-gallery run is needed before comparing
